issues.description: Field 'orders' of class SealSaloon: the problem statement (UML and text) requires a modifiable List<Meal> named 'orders', but the provided codebase (helper utilities and reference solution) uses an array-based representation (Meal[] orders) together with ArrayHelpers. This mismatch (List<Meal> vs Meal[]) can confuse students about which collection type to implement, which APIs to use (java.util.List vs ArrayHelpers), and how tests or the provided template expect the field to be accessed or initialized.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exercise specification and the template consistent. Option A (preferred if the template/helpers remain): update the problem statement and UML to specify an array-based orders attribute (Meal[] orders) and mention ArrayHelpers so students use the provided helpers. Option B: change the template to use a List<Meal> for orders (add java.util.List imports, initialize as new ArrayList<>(), and update/remove ArrayHelpers usage) and update the UML and problem text to request a modifiable List<Meal>. Ensure tests and examples reflect the chosen representation.
